_notes: Character voices (L34). Each key is a voice name used as "voice":"<name>" on a line in tools/voice-lines.json and as say(text,{voice:'<name>'}) in code. voice = ElevenLabs voice id (from the voice library or Voice Design); model / settings / prefix default to the announcer's in voice-lines.json. A cast member with an empty voice id is skipped by make-voices.mjs until it's cast (the game uses its robot voice meanwhile). robot = optional {pitch, rate} for that robot voice (default: a pitch picked from the name). desc = the personality notes the audio agent casts from. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

hank.desc: Hank: gravelly, friendly old-timer next to the start.

garry.desc: Garry the Gnome: a tiny garden gnome on a lawnmower. Whispery, very polite, says please and oh my.

zippy.desc: Zippy the Mail Truck: talks super fast, runs words together, always in a hurry.

fern.desc: Farmer Fern: a red tractor in a straw hat. Loud, happy country farmer who laughs at everything (Ha-HA!).

bubbles.desc: Bubbles the Fire Truck: an eager, squeaky rookie whose voice cracks when excited.

pip.desc: Pip the Ice-Cream Truck: sing-songy and sweet, half-sings lines like an ice-cream jingle.

zorp.desc: Zorp (with Blip): a tiny high, squeaky alien whose saucer crashed in the cornfield; beeps and boops. Blip (low, bubbly) is cast separately as blip.

dot.desc: Dozer Dot: a tough little orange bulldozer. Excited, shouty kid energy, LETS SMASH!

wheelie.desc: Mayor Wheelie: a purple limo in a top hat. Booming, pompous, very proud of himself, rolls his Rs.

kite.desc: Captain Kite: a hovercraft. Laid-back surfer dude, slow and sunny, says duuude.

woolly.desc: Woolly the Sheepdog Van: worried and huffy, out of breath, a little bark in it.

blip.desc: Blip: Zorp's round alien sidekick. Low, slow, bubbly and gurgly, like talking through a fishbowl, says blub and bloop. No lines yet (needs L40 per-line voices).

gertie.desc: Grandma Gertie (Dino Land): an old round brontosaurus in big knitting glasses and a flowery shawl. Slow, warm, forgetful granny; loses her thread mid-sentence ("Now where was I?"), calls you sweetie.

rocky.desc: Rocky Roadster (Dino Land): a caveman car with rock wheels and one bushy eyebrow. Deep, dopey and cheerful; talks about himself in the third person ("Rocky go FAST!").

mo.desc: Mo the Nest-Sitter (Dino Land): a flustered triceratops babysitter in an apron. High, frazzled, breathless bursts; counts everything.

theo.desc: Thunderfoot Theo (Dino Land): a little T-rex in a sweatband. Young sporty kid with coach energy ("C'mon, team!"); jokes about his tiny arms.

petra.desc: Petra Pteranodon (Dino Land): a pilot in goggles and a red scarf. Breezy aviator, crisp radio talk ("Roger that!", "Over!").

rolly.desc: Rolly the Ankylosaurus (Dino Land): a chunky dino in a bowling shirt. Goofy and chuckly, "hyuk hyuk", LOVES the word STRIKE.

digby.desc: Professor Digby (Dino Land): an explorer jeep in a pith helmet with a white mustache. Excited old professor, big words for little things ("Extraordinary!", "Jolly good!").

mossy.desc: Mossy the Swamp Boat (Dino Land): a mossy airboat with sleepy frog eyes. Slow, drawly and relaxed, hums between words ("Mmm...").

rosa.desc: Ranger Rosa (Dino Land): a park-ranger pickup in a ranger hat. Brisk, bossy-but-kind; blows her whistle a lot ("Tweet!").

cinder.desc: Cinder the Dimetrodon (Dino Land): sail-backed, in a sun hat and sunglasses. Hot and bothered, dramatic sighs ("Phew! It's TOASTY!"), calls you honey.

bun.desc: Baker Bun (Candy Land): a puffy cream bun on a cake scooter in a baker's hat. Jolly, puffy and warm; every sentence ends in a giggle ("Hee hee!").

minty.desc: Minty (Candy Land): a peppermint-swirl race car. Cool, breezy surfer-cousin of a peppermint; says "fresh!" and "buddy".

snap.desc: Sergeant Snap (Candy Land): a gingerbread soldier on a cookie tricycle with a drum. Crisp marching-band drill sergeant, but silly ("Left! Right! CRUNCH!").

lolly.desc: Lolly Lou (Candy Land): a go-kart with a giant lollipop head and licorice pigtails. Sugar-crazy cheerleader; squeals "WHEEE!", cheers every little thing. Cast with the ElevenLabs library voice Laura (clearer than the designed voice, whose squeals hid the words).

cocoa.desc: Cocoa (Candy Land): a hot-chocolate mug truck with a marshmallow lid. Cozy and sleepy, big yawns, talks like it's bedtime, trailing off.

glaze.desc: Officer Glaze (Candy Land): a donut police car. Deep, slow, very serious cop who keeps getting distracted by snacks ("Hmm. Suspicious. ...Delicious."). Cast with the ElevenLabs library voice Adam (the account's 30 custom voice slots are full).

wafer.desc: Captain Wafer (Candy Land): a wafer riverboat with a whipped-cream beard. Jolly old sailor, "Ahoy!", "Sweet seas!", "matey". Cast with the ElevenLabs library voice Bill (the account's 30 custom voice slots are full).

jo.desc: Jawbreaker Jo (Candy Land): a rock-candy truck with square teeth. Gravelly, giggly granny who LOVES crunching things; "dearie". Cast with the ElevenLabs library voice Sarah (the account's 30 custom voice slots are full).

fizzy.desc: Fizzy (Candy Land): a soda-bottle jet-ski with a bendy straw. Bubbly and bouncy, burps mid-sentence and says "'scuse me!". Cast with the ElevenLabs library voice Jessica (the account's 30 custom voice slots are full).

sundae.desc: Sundae the Snowplow (Candy Land): an ice-cream-scoop snowplow in a scarf. Shivery, teeth chattering ("B-b-brr!"), but brave and excited. Cast with the ElevenLabs library voice Liam (the account's 30 custom voice slots are full).

puff.desc: Puff (Candy Land): a cotton-candy cloud bus. Dreamy, whispery and floaty; everything is "sooo fluffy". Cast with the ElevenLabs library voice Lily Wolff (the account's 30 custom voice slots are full).
